source.quote: Merging Technologies NADAC specifications and Stereophile, read 2026-11-20: the network input over Ravenna carries 44.1 to 384 kHz plus DSD64, DSD128 and DSD256; the AES input is limited to 44.1-96 kHz. The network is the high-capability input here and AES the compromise, which inverts the pattern every desktop converter in this catalogue follows.
